sys_email_client_template.body_html:
<html>
  <body>
    <p>Hello,</p>

    <p>A new event has been scheduled with the following details:</p>

    <table border="1" cellpadding="5" cellspacing="0">
      <tr>
        <th>Event Name</th>
        <td>${u_event_name}</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <th>Date</th>
        <td>${u_event_date}</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <th>Location</th>
        <td>${u_location}</td>
      </tr>
   
      <tr>
        <th>Status</th>
        <td>${u_status}</td>
      </tr>
  
    </table>

    <p>Please log in to ServiceNow to review and manage the event.</p>

    <p>Regards,<br/>Event Management System</p>
  </body>
</html>
sys_email_client_template.name: Event Scheduling template
sys_email_client_template.subject: New Event has been Scheduled
